name: Weather (script)
author: WinDock
description: Current conditions and a forecast popup from Open-Meteo, with optional daily forecasts on the dock. Choose a place for each widget or use the app's default place.

settings.label: Place
settings.description: The town or city whose weather is shown. Empty: the app's default place.

settings.label: Units
settings.description: Metric shows °C and km/h, imperial °F and mph. Default: metric.

settings.label: Refresh every
settings.description: How often a new forecast is fetched. Default: 30.

settings.label: Show the place under the temperature
settings.description: Writes the place's name under the temperature. Off by default.

settings.label: Show today's high
settings.description: Adds today's highest temperature under the current one. Off by default.

settings.label: Show today's low
settings.description: Adds today's lowest temperature under the current one. Off by default.

settings.label: Forecast on the dock

choices.label: Today's high and low (under the temperature)

settings.description: Days: the weekday, the condition and the high over the low for each day after the current conditions (rows under them on a left or right dock); the slot grows.

settings.label: Days on the dock
settings.description: How many days the forecast on the dock shows. Default: 3.

settings.label: Compact (the glyph only)
settings.description: The temperature is left out; the popup still shows everything.

settings.label: Clicking the widget opens
settings.description: What a click does: open the forecast popup, open the widget's settings to choose the place, or nothing. Default: the forecast popup.

settings.label: Days in the popup
settings.description: How many days the popup's daily forecast lists. Default: 7.

settings.label: Hours in the popup's strip
settings.description: How many hours the popup's hourly strip covers. Default: 24.
